title: Simple Pronouns
description: A lightweight Paper plugin that lets players set pronouns with chat and TAB display support.
body:
# SimplePronouns

SimplePronouns is a lightweight Paper plugin that lets players set, view, and display pronouns on your Minecraft server.

Players can choose their own pronouns, toggle whether they appear in chat or TAB, and server owners can fully customize messages, formats, sounds, cooldowns, and presets.

## Features

- Set custom or preset pronouns
- Show pronouns in chat
- Show pronouns in TAB
- Toggle chat visibility
- Toggle TAB visibility
- View your own pronouns (With Minecraft Color Codes)
- View other players' pronouns
- Admin command to remove a player's pronouns
- Configurable prefix
- Configurable messages
- Configurable sounds
- Preset pronoun list
- Blocked word filter
- Max length protection
- Command cooldown system
- Saves after restart
- No database required

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/pronouns set <pronouns>` | Set your pronouns |
| `/pronouns clear` | Clear your pronouns |
| `/pronouns view` | View your pronouns |
| `/pronouns view <player>` | View another player's pronouns |
| `/pronouns toggle chat` | Toggle chat display |
| `/pronouns toggle tab` | Toggle TAB display |
| `/pronouns list` | View preset pronouns |
| `/pronouns reload` | Reload the config |
| `/pronouns admin remove <player>` | Remove a player's pronouns |

## Permissions

| Permission | Description |
|---|---|
| `simplepronouns.use` | Allows use of `/pronouns` |
| `simplepronouns.custom` | Allows custom pronouns |
| `simplepronouns.view.others` | Allows viewing other players' pronouns |
| `simplepronouns.admin` | Allows admin commands |
| `simplepronouns.cooldown.bypass` | Bypasses command cooldown |

## Example Chat Format
Eclipse [he/him] » Hello

## Example TAB Format
Eclipse [he/him]

## Configuration
SimplePronouns includes a customizable config.yml where you can change:

Prefix
Chat format
TAB format
Messages
Sounds
Cooldown time
Preset pronouns
Blocked words
Max pronoun length
Admin settings

## Requirements
Paper
Minecraft 1.21+
Java 21

## Support

Found a bug or have a suggestion? Join my Discord server or leave feedback on the project page.
